title: Make a Set
directions: Drag objects into the ten-frame. Press Done to check your set.

rounds.context: Use the ten-frame to make the set.
rounds.instruction: Make a set of 5. Put one object in each box. Press Done when finished.
rounds.praise: Nice counting. You made a set of 5.
